title: Casey Adams on podcasting: brand value, imperfect launch, and Spotify tag sharing
summary: Casey hosts Chase Chewning and mostly asks questions; his own contributions are brief. He frames podcasting as a brand and networking tool, shares that he launched imperfectly on AirPods and a $100 mic, and notes that frequent episodes and Spotify tagging drove download spikes.

principles.text: Start a podcast for brand and networking value; it pays back many times over.
principles.quote: starting a podcast is very beneficial to your brand and networking and that's the main reason i do it and there's there's you know it comes back tenfold

principles.text: Ship imperfect and build momentum; quality can improve later.
principles.quote: i not didn't care about the quality but i was just so obsessed with putting it out there getting something going and going with that momentum right like the quality can always become better

principles.text: Don't wait for perfect; take imperfect action.
principles.quote: you can't you know just wait for it to be perfect exactly and then go gotta take imperfect action

principles.text: Frequent episodes drove a spike in downloads.
principles.quote: i saw a huge spike in downloads because i was putting out so many frequent episodes and it was easy to do interviews

principles.text: Share podcast links in a way that lets tagged people reshare in one tap; a big account's reshare spiked downloads.
principles.quote: if i tag you and i'm sharing your our spotify podcast link and it's on my instagram story and i tag you if you share that post you automatically share the spotify podcast
